response.rationale: Both forms naturally mean the current amount in a bank account. Indonesian commonly uses “saldo rekening,” while Malaysian Malay commonly uses “baki akaun,” giving a useful everyday contrast.
response.risk_rationale: Cross-border banking and digital usage may expose Malaysian speakers to “saldo akaun.”
response.shared_synonym_rationale: “Saldo akaun” may occur in Malaysian usage, especially under Indonesian or technical influence, but “baki akaun” remains a credible Malaysian preference; this does not undermine the contrast.
